new_today_news.headline: Q&A Exclusive: National Restaurant Association President Michelle Korsmo on 2026 Restaurant Show
new_today_news.summary: NRA CEO discusses 2026 restaurant industry outlook, highlighting operational challenges, technology adoption, and workforce development priorities that affect all segments of the food service ecosystem.

new_today_news.headline: Royal Waste Services Expands Mack LR Electric Garbage Truck Fleet in New York City
new_today_news.summary: Royal Waste Services announced expansion of its Mack LR Electric refuse truck fleet in the Bronx following successful initial deployment. The fleet features advanced electric powertrains with 376 kWh batteries, two high-efficiency motors, and regenerative braking for improved efficiency on stop-and-go collection routes.

recent_news.headline: CDL Driver Shortage Continues to Affect Waste Services Across U.S.
recent_news.summary: Trucking sector faces capacity tightening and rate increases driven by CDL shortage. Federal rule effective March 2026 restricts asylum seekers and refugees from obtaining CDLs, affecting foreign-born drivers who account for one in six truckers. Regional imbalances most acute in Southeast, Texas, and Mountain West.

recent_news.headline: The restaurant labor market in 6 key statistics
recent_news.summary: Restaurant Dive updates labor market statistics for 2026, covering employment trends and hiring challenges in the food service industry relevant to waste management service providers.

backfill_news.headline: Washington DC restaurants face wave of high-profile closures amid labor costs and office culture shifts
backfill_news.summary: D.C. downtown restaurant closures continue despite positive opening-to-closing ratio. Labor costs and Initiative 82's tipped minimum wage increase to $17.50 cited as key challenges for operators.
